info.title: opencode HttpApi
info.description: Experimental HttpApi surface for selected instance routes.

get.description: Return the server identity, connection URLs, paths, and readiness status.
Retrieve enabled server plugins and their current status.

schema.description: Maximum number of sessions to return. Defaults to the newest 50 sessions.
Session order for the first page. Use desc for newest first or asc for oldest first.

anyOf.description: Filter by parent session. Use null to return only root sessions.

get.description: Retrieve sessions in the requested order. Items keep that order across pages; use cursor.next or cursor.previous to move through the ordered list.

post.description: Create a session at the requested location. A parentID creates a linked child session at its parent's location.

get.description: Aggregate local session activity, usage, and tool reliability for a time range.

post.description: Import a projected session transcript at the requested location. Accepts transcripts exported by earlier releases. If parentID is supplied, the parent session must already exist; import parents before children.

get.description: Export a complete projected session transcript.
Retrieve foreground Session drains currently owned by this OpenCode process. Sessions absent from the result are inactive.
Retrieve a session by ID.

delete.description: Delete a session and its child sessions.

archived.description: Archive the session with true or restore it with false. Repeating the current state is a no-op.

post.description: Create a child session by copying projected history before a message. Omit before to copy the full history.
Switch the agent used by subsequent provider turns.
Switch the model used by subsequent provider turns.
Move a session to another project directory at the requested delivery boundary.
Durably admit one session input and schedule agent-loop execution unless resume is false.
Execute a slash command callback immediately.
Activate a skill for a session by appending a skill message and resuming execution.
Durably admit synthetic session input and schedule execution unless resume is false.
Execute one shell command in the session's working directory. Emits a shell.started event before execution and a shell.ended event with the merged output after.
Durably admit a session compaction request. Steers by default: it runs at the next step boundary instead of waiting behind queued prompts.
Wait for a session agent loop to become idle.
Stage or move a reversible session boundary and optionally apply its file changes.

get.description: Retrieve the active context messages for a session (all messages after the last compaction).

schema.description: User message whose turn to diff. Defaults to the turn of the newest user message.
Later user message whose turn ends the range. Defaults to the turn of `from` alone.
Unchanged lines around each hunk. Omit for full-file patches.

get.description: Structured per-file diffs of the files a turn changed. A turn runs from the first prompt after the session was last idle until its next idle marker, so prompts steered in while it was busy belong to the same turn; `to` extends the range through a later turn. Compares the range's first recorded snapshot with its last; a step still running in the active session compares against the working copy. Ranges that span a location change are rejected. In sessions without any idle marker, a prompt's turn spans until the next user message.
List durable enqueued session work not yet delivered, ordered by enqueue sequence. Includes user, synthetic, compaction, and move items.

delete.description: Cancel an inbox item that has not yet been delivered. Unavailable items are a no-op.

patch.description: Change a pending inbox item's delivery mode. Steering wakes session execution.

get.description: List API-managed instruction entries attached to the session.

put.description: Attach or replace one durable instruction entry. Changes announce as updates at the next step boundary.

delete.description: Remove one instruction entry; the removal is announced to the model at the next step boundary.

post.description: Generate transient text from the current session context without mutating session history.

get.description: Experimental durable session event log. Reads events after an exclusive aggregate sequence and continues with live events when follow=true.

post.description: Interrupt active execution owned by this OpenCode process. Returns interrupted=true when an active execution was interrupted and false for the idle no-op. When resume=true, execution resumes pending steering input and next-in-line control items (manual compaction, moves) while queued prompts remain parked.
Move active foreground backgroundable tools for this session into background observation. Idle requests are a no-op.

get.description: Retrieve one projected message owned by the Session.
Retrieve pending forms for a session.

post.description: Create a form for a session.

get.description: Retrieve a form and its current state for a session.

delete.description: Cancel a pending form, optionally telling the asker why it was not answered.

post.description: Submit an answer to a pending form.

put.description: Replace the process environment used by local shell commands for this session.

post.description: Mark the idle transition observed by the viewer as viewed.

schema.description: Maximum number of messages to return. When omitted, the endpoint returns its default page size.
Message order for the first page. Use desc for newest first or asc for oldest first.

anyOf.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as cursor.previous or cursor.next in the previous response. Do not combine with order.

schema.description: Filter by message type before pagination. When omitted, all message types are returned. Pass the same type when following cursors.

get.description: Retrieve projected messages for a session, optionally filtered by type. Items keep the requested order across pages; use cursor.next or cursor.previous to move through the ordered timeline, passing the same type filter on each page.
Retrieve pending forms for a location.
Retrieve pending permission requests for a location.
Retrieve saved permissions, optionally filtered by project.

patch.description: Change the action or resource of a saved permission. Fails with a conflict when the project already has a saved permission with the same action and resource.

delete.description: Remove a saved permission by ID.

post.description: Evaluate and, when approval is required, create a permission request for a session.

get.description: Retrieve pending permission requests owned by a session.
Retrieve a pending permission request owned by a session.

post.description: Respond to a pending permission request owned by a session.
Dispatch a method to the currently registered RPC at the requested location.

schema.description: Only send events of these types, plus the initial server.connected event. When omitted, all events are sent.

get.description: Subscribe to native events and plugin RPC events across all server locations. Volatile by contract: a slow consumer overflows and fails the stream, and events during disconnection are missed.

Read the last physical rows without changing selection or taking control. Omitted lines uses the live terminal height; larger counts include retained history. Blank rows are preserved. Screen dimensions and cursor remain relative to the live screen. Returns null when no current terminal exists. Selection is server-local and resets on restart. Experimental: may change without compatibility guarantees.
get.summary: Read the session's most recently controlled terminal

post.description: Schedule a prompt that wakes the Session once after a delay, at a time, every interval, or on a cron. Experimental: needs experimental.schedules in the Session's config and may change without notice.

get.description: List a Session's schedules, oldest first. Experimental: needs experimental.schedules in the Session's config and may change without notice.
Read one schedule. Experimental: needs experimental.schedules in the Session's config and may change without notice.

delete.description: Delete a schedule. Experimental: needs experimental.schedules in the Session's config and may change without notice.

post.description: Stop a schedule from firing until it is resumed. Experimental: needs experimental.schedules in the Session's config and may change without notice.

Resume a paused schedule. A one-shot that fell due while paused fires once; a repeating schedule resumes at its next slot. Experimental: needs experimental.schedules in the Session's config and may change without notice.

value.description: JSON value attached to the session's instructions

run.description: Shell command to run in the Session's directory. Alone, exit 0 wakes and stdout is appended.

code.description: Code Mode JavaScript check (no fetch; 30s, 20 tool calls, 32 KB output cap). Call tools statically as tools.<ns>.<tool>(...) or tools["ns-name"].tool(...); each is authorized once at creation to run unattended. Runs once at creation with state = null (if baselines state without waking; until matches immediately if true), with globals state, now (epoch ms) and runs. Return a boolean or { wake, state?, message? } (message is appended to prompt on wake), e.g.: const t = await tools.slack.read_thread({ id }); return { wake: state !== null && t.count > state.count, state: { count: t.count }, message: "New reply" }

prompt.description: The message the Session receives when the schedule wakes.

Schedule.Duration.description: A duration such as "90 seconds", "5 minutes" or "2 hours".

interrupted.description: Whether an active execution owned by this OpenCode process was interrupted.

SessionsCursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as cursor.previous or cursor.next in the previous response.
